### Describe the bug

`internal/skills/lockfile/lockfile.go` says the skill lock file is shared with the Vercel `skills` CLI on purpose:

```go
// lockVersion must match Vercel's CURRENT_LOCK_VERSION

comments.body:
Thanks for the detailed report! I verified this against current `trunk` (commit [`9490d20`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/9490d204a2ba95434153dedce99898ce9f281426/internal/skills/lockfile/lockfile.go#L43-L49)): `lockfilePath()` unconditionally returns `$HOME/.agents/.skill-lock.json` and never consults `XDG_STATE_HOME`, so it diverges from the Vercel `skills` CLI's lock path despite the comment stating the format is meant to interoperate. No duplicate issues found. I'm suggesting `bug` given the clear, verified code evidence and reproduction steps, and `priority-3` since it only affects the subset of users who set `XDG_STATE_HOME` and use both tools together (workaround: manually point both tools at the same path, or symlink). A maintainer should confirm whether honoring `XDG_STATE_HOME` (as proposed) is the desired fix, consistent with the `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` precedent mentioned in the issue.
